<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="exX0032026-03-2510-15-30" status="unreviewed"> 
         <milestone n="Lineage of the Pramāṇavārttika (ID:3772)" unit="section"/>
         <rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3772">tshad ma rnam 'grel</rs> gyi brgyud pa'i skabs|
         <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:7966">thub pa</rs> | 
         dgra bcom chos skyob | 
         paN chen me waM ga 
         dbyig gnyen| 
         phyogs glang | 
         dbang phyug sde | 
         chos grags| 
         <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:5554">lha dbang blo</rs> | 
         <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:5549">shakya blo</rs> | 
         <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:">dul ba lha</rs> | chos grags | sher 'byung | nyi ma sbas pa | ja ma ri | dznya na shrI mi tra | chos kyi mchog Ananda| waM ku panTi ta| kha che paN chen shAkya shrI | sa paN | 'u yug pa| zhang btsun mdo sde dpal | 'jam dbyangs skya bo | dpal ldan pa | 'jam dbyangs ston gzhon | nor bzangs dpal | grags rin pa | 'jam ston pa | chos seng pa | rdo thog pa chos kyi bzang po | mkhan chen rin po che rgyal mtshan bzang po | 
         
         yang | chos seng ba la rgyal lha khang ba bsam grub ye shes| de la slob dpon bsam grub bzang po ba rnams te| 'di rnam 'grel ba gzhan rnams la mi snang bas| mkhan chen rin po che rgyal mtshan bzang pos 'bad pa chen pos btsal bas rnyed pa yin gsung ste| tshad ma rnam 'grel gyi brgyud pa'o ||</seg></TEI>
